question: When you are following another vehicle on a wet road, you should keep

options.text: 2 seconds behind.
More than 2 seconds behind.
Less than 2 seconds behind.

question: If a fire engine behind you sounds the siren, you should

options.text: Continue at normal speed.
Move to the side, slow down or stop if necessary.
Increase your speed and move to the side.

question: On a one way street, you hear the siren of an emergency vehicle behind you, you should

options.text: Give way by moving to the left only.
Give way by moving to the left or right.
Stop immediately.

question: How should you deal with floods?

options.text: Drive through as fast as possible to avoid stopping.
Drive through slowly in 1st gear.
Drive through in the highest gear.

question: To maintain good lane discipline, you should

options.text: Form up correctly into the intended lane before reaching the junction.
Drive between lanes so that you can switch lane easily.
Follow closely to the vehicle in front.

question: In which situation should you switch on the high beam?

options.text: When driving on a bumpy road.
When there are oncoming vehicles.
When the road is poorly lighted and there is no traffic ahead.

question: On a sharp bend at night, to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic, you should

options.text: Switch off your lights.
Dip your headlights.
Swith on high beam.

notes: Source typo in option C: 'Swith' (should be 'Switch'); kept as printed.

question: You may drive along the right-most lane when

options.text: You are travelling at the speed limits.
The traffic is not heavy.
You are overtaking another vehicle.

question: You are not allowed to drive into a bus lane on Monday to Saturday from

options.text: 7.30 am to 9.30 am.
7.00 am to 9.30 am.

question: Fastening a seat belt can

options.text: Reduce the chances of a collision.
Reduce the chances of being seriously injured or killed.
Control your body movement when you negotiate a sharp bend.

question: This sign means
picture: Blue circular sign with two white arrows pointing diagonally down-left and down-right

options.text: Split traffic - vehicles may pass on either side.
Two-way traffic - beware of traffic from right and left.
Turn either side - vehicles must turn right or left.

question: When you see this sign,
picture: Red octagonal sign with white border and the word "STOP" in white

options.text: You must stop and give way to traffic on a major road.
You need not stop if there is no traffic on a major road.
You need not stop if you are turning left.

question: This sign means
picture: Blue circular sign with a red border and a red diagonal cross

options.text: You may stop for a short while so long as you remain in the car.
You cannot wait but you can stop to let down or pick up passengers.
You cannot stop your vehicle at all.

question: When you see this sign, you
picture: Red-bordered white circular sign with a black left-turn arrow crossed by a red diagonal bar

options.text: Must turn left as there are no other roads ahead.
Cannot turn left but may go straight or turn right.
May turn left on Sundays and Public holidays.

question: On seeing this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black fence-like symbol of vertical pickets

options.text: Drive carefully as there is guard-rail along the road side.
Drive carefully and look out for level gate closing.
Slow down as there is an Army rocket launching range ahead.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black plus-shaped cross symbol

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully in the hospital area.
Drive carefully and give way to the 'Red Cross' ambulance.
Slow down and apply the 'Give-way Rule' at the cross-road ahead.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black T-shaped symbol

options.text: Slow down and give way to traffic from right and left.
Slow down and make a U-turn - road ends ahead.
Slow down as there is a Trailer parking area ahead.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black vertical line and a short branch to the right

options.text: Not slow down as you have the right of way.
Slow down, beware of traffic from the right.
Not turn right as the road is closed to traffic.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black vertical line and a short branch to the left

options.text: Not slow down as you have the right of way.
Slow down and beware of traffic from the left.
Not turn left as the road is closed to traffic.

question: This sign means that you are
picture: Blue square sign with white converging road lanes passing under a white overhead crossbar

options.text: Approaching a Pedestrian Overhead Bridge - beware of jay-walkers.
Entering an Expressway - comply with the expressway rules.
Approaching an MRT station - beware of commuters in the vicinity.
